title: GitHub sign-in during agent setup's Apply still waits inside one call
text: Machine browser approval in yoke setup --agent ends each call and resumes on the next. The GitHub device sign-in that Apply runs still prints a browser line and waits in the same command until the person finishes, so a caller that stops that call loses the sign-in. Making it resumable needs Apply to persist its own pending device flow; that is a separate decision routed to steering.
